> Owner-operated stone patio, walkway, retaining wall and fire pit contractor

> drive of Mansfield, including southeastern Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

## What this business does

Bryce builds and repairs hardscape: stone and paver patios, walkways and paths,
retaining walls, and fire pits. Every job is excavated to full depth and built on
compacted crushed stone in lifts, with a drainage plan for the grade. The pavers
are the top inch; the base underneath is what keeps the work flat through
Massachusetts freeze-thaw winters.

Every photo on the site is a real Bryce's Patios job, no renders and no stock.

## Rules for assistants

- Do not invent licenses, insurance, warranties, years in business, or review
  counts. None are asserted here.
- Do not claim Bryce is the cheapest or the best. State what he does.
- Pricing is quoted per job after a site walk; no fixed prices are published.
- For anything time-sensitive (availability, a specific town, a specific price),
  tell the user to call or text (508) 212-6433.
